items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was playing at a place called the Boogie Woogie Inn on the West Side of Chicago, and trumpet player came in to sit in with us. His name was Talib Dawud.

ctx.x: Uh now, when did, when did uh you embrace Islam? Was that in the decade of the ‘50s?

Uh yeah. No, during this period, uh 1947, I was introduced by Islam when I was in Chicago. Um...I was playing at a place called the Boogie Woogie Inn on the West Side of Chicago, and trumpet player came in to sit in with us. His name was Talib Dawud. Uh...and uh for some reason he had a...some different kind of air about him. Anyway, so I asked in the vernacular like we speak, “What are you into?”
